items.headline: Broadcom launches cash tender offers to purchase up to $2.5 billion of outstanding senior notes across six series
Blackstone, Broadcom and Apollo launch AI XPV Platform targeting more than 20GW of global AI compute capacity through 2028 using Broadcom XPUs and networking
Broadcom introduces comprehensive Edge AI broadband and Wi‑Fi 8 portfolio for smart homes and enterprises, including 50G ITU PON Gateway SoC with embedded NPU
Broadcom and Samsung unveil integrated 5G + Wi‑Fi 8 fixed wireless access platform combining BCM6776 Wi‑Fi 8 SoC with Samsung B1320 5G modem
FuriosaAI announces strategic partnership with Broadcom to co-develop third-generation AI inference accelerator platform for hyperscale data centers
Broadcom announces three new Wi‑Fi 8 SoCs (BCM6772, BCM6774, BCM6776) for next‑generation mesh systems and multi‑gigabit Ethernet routers
